description: This file defines and configures an Axios API client for interacting with the CHRIS backend service, including request and response interceptors for authentication token injection, timing, and error handling.

methods.name: axios.create
methods.description: Creates an Axios instance configured with base URL, timeout, and headers.

methods.name: api.interceptors.request.use
methods.description: Adds a request interceptor to inject authentication tokens and measure request start time.

methods.name: api.interceptors.response.use
methods.description: Adds a response interceptor for timing, error handling, and specific response-based actions.
